Piles, also known as hemorrhoids, are swollen blood vessels in and around the anus. They can cause pain, itching, irritation, swelling and bleeding during bowel movements. Constipation, hard stools and excessive straining can aggravate the condition.
In this video, Hansaji explains natural ways to manage piles through better bowel habits, suitable yoga practices, dietary changes and simple traditional remedies.
What you will learn:
1. Toilet habits: Respond to the urge to pass stools, avoid straining and do not sit on the toilet for prolonged periods.
